topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: Hey! I saw your email, and wow, I didn’t expect that at all. Your essay? In the example section? That’s massive! But you know, it’s such a good thing—I mean, everyone’s going to see how amazing you are. They’ll see the real you, all the thoughts and feelings you poured into it. It’s like your voice is out there, louder and clearer than ever. And I know it feels like a lot, but think about all the people who might be inspired by your words. You’ve always had a way with words, and now, here’s proof for everyone to see. Just take a deep breath, okay? And remember, whatever happens, you’re already a star.
